Dear [Mr Craik](../persons.html#379)
Would you be so kind as to direct this letter on to Miss [Frances Martin](../persons.html#971).

The address on her letter was printed in some ‘old English type’ and after much consideration I decided that the word looked more like Carrara than anything else but the Post acknowledges no such place.

Thank you for your letter. I think this will suit us, but I will write on to [Miss Coleridge](../persons.html#329).

If you do not hear in three or four days, consider that we consent[^1]

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: This means \'consent to the terms proposed for the volume publication of [Strolling Players](../books.html#229)\' which they had written together and which had been coming out in [MP](../others.html#52).
